cause: The P6 merge exposed two real generic-workflow boundary defects: an ARMA-GARCH temporary run lacked its artifact index and optional P7 options were not projected as nullable in the closed workflow schema.
impact: The integration tree could not complete the generic lineage guard or the full P7 workflow matrix until both boundaries were fixed.
lesson: A generic adapter must initialize every pack-owned durable boundary and project optional-value semantics identically into runtime validation and published closed schemas.
